reason: Source keeps the messenger's servile 'I venture to say'.

new: at your mamma's request, to that effect

old: Raskolnikov continued to stare in wild bewilderment.
new: Raskolnikov still stared wildly, with strained attention.

reason: Source: 'she loves to do anything for me'.

old: all of them, brother, every last one.
new: all of them, brother, every last one -- I know everything.
reason: Source: 'all, all, brother, I know everything'.

new: She's essentially, essentially an unaccountable character!

old: Raskolnikov glanced at it and turned
new: Raskolnikov looked at him and turned
reason: Source: 'Raskolnikov looked at him' (at Razumihin), not at the note.

old: That's what I've forgotten -- forgot it on purpose.
new: That's what I've forgotten -- as though on purpose -- forgot it all at once!
reason: Source: 'forgotten, as though on purpose; forgotten it all at once'; the candidate turns 'as though on purpose' into a deliberate act.

old: "They'll be a long time getting rid of these people," he thought.
new: "It'll be a long time before I get rid of them," he thought.
reason: Source: 'It will be long before I get rid of them'; the candidate reverses who gets rid of whom.

old: The psychological evidence alone should be enough to put them on the right track.
new: The psychological evidence alone could show how to get on the track of the real man.
reason: Source: 'One can show from the psychological data alone how to get on the track of the real man'; 'the real man' (someone other than the painter) was lost.

old: And if any rumors come up, I will take them to the police.
new: And if anything turns up, if I hear any rumors, I will take it to the police.
reason: Source: 'if anything turns up, if I hear any rumours, I'll take it to the police'; 'take them' made it the rumors he would hand over.

old: So they brought him in with a proper escort.
new: So they took him to that police station -- the one here -- with a proper escort.
reason: Source: 'they took him to that police station--that is here--with a suitable escort'; the local station matters to the plot.

old: Why did you not go to work with Dmitri the next day?
new: Why did you not go to work with Dmitri the other day?
reason: Source: 'the other day'; 'the next day' changes the chronology.

old: That I would be accused. -- Now, Zossimov,
new: That I would be accused. How could you be terrified, if you felt free from guilt? -- Now, Zossimov,
reason: Source: ''How could you be frightened, if you felt free from guilt?''; without it 'that question' in the next sentence refers to nothing.

old: He must have been talking in his sleep
new: He must have woken from a dream
reason: Source: 'He must have waked from a dream'.
